How to Apply to the HGSFP
Do you already have a confirmed supervisor and secured funding?
If yes – both supervisor and funding are secured:
You can register at any time directly with the Central Office of the HGSFP.
Please use the registration forms provided here and contact: office@hgsfp.uni-heidelberg.de.
If no – you are missing either a supervisor or funding (or both):
You can apply once per year through the HGSFP web form to:
Apply for a fellowship
Be matched with a supervisor and doctoral project
Application for the Annual Calls
The application portal for 2027 is now open:
> Application Portal
Deadline: 1st November 2026
You can start the application process and edit your application form at any time as soon as the portal opens and up to the deadline.
Topical Graduate Schools
Learn more and apply directly through each school's own website (see list of schools in the righthand column), where doctoral positions are sometimes offered outside of the regular HGSFP call.
Optionally select one or more of these schools during the annual HGSFP application. This is non-binding and simply indicates your interest.
Each school makes independent admission decisions. Applying to one school has no effect on decisions from others.
